correctness.rationale: For every prime p and 1≤s<n, the nilpotent associative multiplication p^s ab makes the circle operation a brace. The lambda actions are exactly the principal units and rho maps preserve their orbits. Counting valuation strata proves each orbit size and multiplicity; the criterion p^s ab=0 is uniform on a fixed orbit square and equivalent to 2j≤n-s. The three probability formulas follow from complete, disjoint counts; a geometric-series limit gives p^(1-s)/(p+1). The standalone verifier directly enumerates orbit closures and event pairs for 25 parameter triples with no counterexample. Infinite generality relies on the proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 work motivates comparing probabilities of local flip behavior and global indecomposable-component membership. The natural cyclic radical brace family exhibits an exact componentwise valuation threshold and nontrivial joint-event law, while for fixed p,s one probability tends to zero and the other to p^(1-s)/(p+1)>0. This is a complete structural explanation of two sharply different notions of probabilistic triviality, not a numerical sample or arbitrary parameter slice.
